title: Classic Glazed Meatloaf with Baked Potatoes
subtitle: a tender, well-seasoned meatloaf with a tangy brown sugar and ketchup glaze, and baked potatoes from the same oven
imageAlt: Thick slices of glazed meatloaf beside a split baked potato with butter on a white plate on a navy napkin
servingsNote: dinner for two, plus meatloaf sandwiches for days

breakdown: Butter & sour cream, for the potatoes
Onion, garlic, milk, Worcestershire, dried thyme, salt, pepper

beforeYouStart.text: Oven at 180°C (350°F). The potatoes go in first; the meatloaf joins them.
Mix with your hands, just until combined. Overmixing makes it dense.

steps.title: Potatoes in
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Prick the potatoes a few times with a fork, rub with the oil and salt and set them right on the oven rack. Bake 70–80 minutes in all; the meatloaf joins them partway.

steps.title: Soak the crumbs
steps.text: In a large bowl, stir the panko, milk and eggs together and let stand 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add the beef, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, dried thyme, salt and pepper and mix gently with your hands just until combined.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: On a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, shape into a loaf about 23 × 12 cm.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Stir the ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar together and spread half over the loaf.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake beside the potatoes 45 minutes, spread on the rest of the glaze, and bake 10–15 minutes more, until the centre reads 71°C (160°F).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes, then slice. Split the potatoes and serve with the butter and sour cream.

fixIt.fix: Rest the full 10 minutes before cutting, and use a serrated knife.
Don't skip soaking the crumbs, mix gently, and pull it at 71°C.
Add the second coat later, for the last 10 minutes only.
Large potatoes take up to 90 minutes. Squeeze with an oven mitt: they should give easily.

saleTip: Russets are cheapest in 10 lb bags, often $3.99–4.99 at No Frills. Use the rest for mash and soup.
swap: Loaf pan: pack into a 23 × 13 cm (9 × 5-inch) pan; add 10 minutes and pour off the fat before slicing.
leftovers: Cold meatloaf sandwiches with ketchup, or slices pan-fried until crisp at the edges.
doneness: 71°C (160°F) in the centre of the loaf (Health Canada, ground beef). Reheat to 74°C (165°F).
source: Based on tested meatloaf methods (Canadian Living, America's Test Kitchen): a milk-soaked breadcrumb panade, free-form loaf baked at 180°C (350°F) to 71°C with a two-coat ketchup glaze.
prepAhead: Shape the loaf up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; add 5–10 minutes to the bake.
reheat: Slices covered with foil at 180°C (350°F) 15 minutes, or in a skillet 2–3 minutes a side, until 74°C (165°F).

basic.note: Simple meatloaf with salt, pepper and a ketchup-brown sugar glaze.

stepNotes.2: Basic: skip the garlic, Worcestershire and dried thyme.
stepNotes.4: Basic: ketchup and brown sugar only.

fancy.note: Wrapped in bacon, with loaded baked potatoes.

stepNotes.3: Fancy: drape the bacon strips across the loaf and tuck the ends under.
stepNotes.6: Fancy: top the split potatoes with the cheddar and return to the oven 2 minutes to melt.

plating: Potato split and fluffed with a fork.
Buttered peas or green beans for colour.

why.1-0: Crumbs soaked in milk keep the meatloaf moist and tender.
why.2-2: Vinegar keeps the glaze tangy, not candy-sweet.

funFact: Meatloaf became a North American staple in the Depression, as a way to stretch a pound of meat to feed a family.

keeps.note: freeze slices with parchment between them
